column1: # O1 D10: network, repair and sharing rows

column3: Wi-Fi: QR code of the current network
column9: Shows the password and a QR code of the connected network (scan it with a phone). The password is visible on screen: do not do this while sharing the screen.
Latency, download (50 MB) and upload (20 MB) against speed.cloudflare.com; no account, nothing is stored. Uses real traffic.
Asks first. A running call or recording drops while the audio stack restarts; audio-ensure runs afterwards.
Asks first. The connection drops for a few seconds.
Asks first. The touchpad is disabled for a second and enabled again (device config in Hyprland).
Asks first. The notification history is lost.

column3: Transcode a picture or video for sharing
column9: Pick a file from the screenshot, recording and download folders, a format and a size (3160/2160/1080 px pictures, 1080p/720p/4k videos, GIF). The result is saved next to the original and its file:// URI is copied for drag and drop.

column3: Download the video from the clipboard URL (yt-dlp)
column9: Copy a video URL first (Zen, Telegram, anywhere). The file lands in ~/Videos/downloads.

column3: Media: player menu (next, previous, focus the player)
column9: The same menu as a right click on the waybar media module.
Type a time first: 25 (minutes), 90s, 2h, 1h30, or a time of day 14:30, then the text. The notification is critical (stays until dismissed). Timers are transient: they do not survive a reboot.
Pending reminders with the time left; d or Alt+d cancels the selected one.

column6: systemctl --user $(systemctl --user is-active -q crash-watch.service && echo stop || echo start) crash-watch.service
column9: ON = a toast appears when one of your programs dumps core (click: details; SUPER+ALT+X: ask Claude, mute). waybar is skipped (its watchdog reports it).

column3: Crash toasts: edit the mute list
column9: One program name per line; those programs never raise a crash toast.
Offline voice typing into the focused window (local Whisper small). Hold F9 to dictate, or press the toggle twice. Pauses playing media. Never start it during a call.
auto-detect misfires on short clips: pin ru, uk or en when you dictate in one language. Restarts the daemon.

column3: Dictation: download the Whisper model (small, ~466 MB)
column9: ~/.local/share/voxtype/models/ggml-small.bin, resumable. Also the model for the planned Telegram voice transcription.

Unattached term-* tmux sessions left by terminal windows that were closed before destroy-unattached worked. Lists each with what runs in it (idle shells alone say so), Tab multi-selects, Enter then asks once before killing only the picked ones. Same list as tmux prefix+X, NORMAL D.
